acceptance_receipt.root_acceptance: Accepted after scoped declarative spec assessment, source review, exact standalone native/WPT comparison, complete restoration and independent results review.
acceptance_receipt.discovery: Source and browser investigation of the viewport-provider obligation exposed hidden-embedding failures after expanded114; the subsequent Lean model separates request, completion and publication.
acceptance_receipt.formal_scope: Nine independently replayed abstract provider-state results and two rejected false claims. CSS-required extent and successful completion are supplied premises; native scheduling, lifetime, IEEE arithmetic and full implementation refinement remain unproved.
acceptance_receipt.applicability: Standalone five-native-plus-one-WPT variant was built and tested on normalized HEAD90 without pending native overlays. Stack variant preserves114/115 and applies/reverses exactly; its101-case installation run is pending. No clean-upstream/release/all-platform claim.
acceptance_receipt.scope: Connected same-origin ordinary iframes with definite containing blocks and viewport-relative SVGLength getter/conversion; one/two iframe levels with outer visibility/size histories. Nested both-hidden, reentrant embedding changes and performance not measured.
acceptance_receipt.triage: SVG API value correctness after hidden iframe layout/resize; no demonstrated security impact.
acceptance_receipt.signing: Pending existing signing hold; no unsigned fallback.
